description: The bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates the GPU Memory usage in gigabytes across different fine-tuning methods for language models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical data, displaying six methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, with the text labels rotated diagonally. The vertical axis represents the value axis, labeled "GPU Memory (GB)," utilizing a linear scale with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20 (from 0 to 60) and featuring corresponding light gray horizontal gridlines. The chart consists of simple, unstacked vertical bars that are not sorted in strict ascending or descending order, though values generally decrease from left to right before the final category. The first five categories are represented by orange bars. The "Full FT" bar is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 74 GB. This is followed by "MTL-FT" at approximately 39 GB, while "TAG" and "LoRA" both show values of approximately 21 GB. The "QLoRA" bar is the shortest, measuring roughly 13 GB. The final category, labeled "Ours," is visually emphasized in two ways: its corresponding bar is colored green rather than orange, and its x-axis text label is printed in a bold typeface, showing an approximate value of 21 GB.
